test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A parliamentary executive is:

options.text: where the parliament functions as the executive
an executive where there is a parliament
an executive elected by the parliament
an executive who is dependent on the support of the majority in the parliament

solution:
The correct answer is __**an executive who is dependent on the support of the majority in the parliament**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **parliamentary executive is an executive that is dependent on the support of the majority in the parliament**.
 
• It can also mean an executive that is elected by the parliament or where the parliament functions as the executive. 
 
• In a parliamentary system, **the head of government is accountable to the legislature and derives their legitimacy from the support of the majority in the legislature.**
 
• The** legislature has the power to exercise political and financial control over the executive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __Some of the features of a parliamentary form of government are:__

 
• ​The Prime Minister along with the Council of Ministers form the executive and the Parliament is the legislature.
 
• The PM and the ministers are elected from the members of parliament, implying that the executive emerges out of the legislature.
 
• The executive is responsible to the legislature.
 
• There is a collective responsibility, that is, each minister’s responsibility is the responsibility of the whole Council.
 
• Most parliamentary democracies follow bicameral legislature.
 
• 
 
The term of the government depends on its majority support in the lower house. If the government does not win a vote of no confidence, the council of ministers has to resign. Elections will be held and a new government is formed
